name: Precinct 20: Dead Strange
storyline: Precinct 20: Dead Strange puts you in the role of Detective Innis Garris of Precinct 20's Homicide Squad, investigating a series of bizarre ritual murders. The trail leads to a cult known as “The Sons of Albhukra” and sinister figures such as the Birdman, who pecks out his victims' eyes, and the so-called Slenderman, who preys on lonely pedestrians. As you make your way through dark streets and crime scenes, you must follow clues, survive the dangers, and uncover what lies behind the seemingly supernatural killings. The goal is to track down the murderers and bring the killing spree to an end.
